meaning: profaneness, commonness, unholy, profane, common, sand

elsewhere.note: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.
The priest answered David, and said, “I have no common bread, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.”
